question: 已送达订单从下单到批准的平均耗时是多少天？

question: 按订单状态统计各状态下的订单数量，列出全部状态。

question: 2017年订单量最多的前5个客户城市是哪些？
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_city, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_cnt FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01' GROUP BY c.customer_city ORDER BY order_cnt DESC LIMIT 5;

question: 平均客单价最高的前3个州是哪些？客单价=该州已送达订单总金额(含运费)除以该州订单数。
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_state, ROUND(SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS aov FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY aov DESC LIMIT 3;

question: pet_shop 宠物用品品类 2018年已送达订单的总销售额是多少(含运费)？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value), 2) AS total FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN product_category_translation pct ON p.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND pct.product_category_name_english = 'pet_shop' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01';

question: 2018年购买过 health_beauty 美妆健康品类商品的客户有多少位(去重)？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS customer_cnt FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN product_category_translation pct ON p.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND pct.product_category_name_english = 'health_beauty' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01';

question: 2017年销售额最高的卖家是谁(列出卖家ID和销售额)？销售额含运费。
gold_sql: SELECT oi.seller_id, ROUND(SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value), 2) AS total FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01' GROUP BY oi.seller_id ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 1;

question: 评价分数为1分的订单中，哪个州的订单数量最多？
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_state, COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id) AS cnt FROM order_reviews r JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE r.review_score = 1 GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1;

question: 里约热内卢州(RJ)已送达订单中，使用过信用卡支付的订单占比是多少？(结果用 0~1 小数表示，如 0.36 表示 36%)
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(1.0 * (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o2.order_id) FROM orders o2 JOIN customers c2 ON o2.customer_id = c2.customer_id JOIN order_payments op2 ON o2.order_id = op2.order_id WHERE o2.order_status='delivered' AND c2.customer_state='RJ' AND op2.payment_type='credit_card') / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o3.order_id) FROM orders o3 JOIN customers c3 ON o3.customer_id = c3.customer_id WHERE o3.order_status='delivered' AND c3.customer_state='RJ'), 4) AS ratio;

question: 平均运费最高的前3个州是哪些(按收货客户所在州统计，含运费口径的每单平均)？
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_state, ROUND(AVG(oi.freight_value), 2) AS avg_freight FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY avg_freight DESC LIMIT 3;

question: 2018年各州订单量排名前5的州是哪些？

question: 收到评价数最多的前3个卖家是哪些(按被评价的订单数计，列出卖家ID和评价订单数)？

question: 从下单到送达客户平均耗时最短的前3个州是哪些？
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_state, ROUND(AVG(julianday(o.order_delivered_customer_date) - julianday(o.order_purchase_timestamp)), 2) AS avg_days FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY avg_days ASC LIMIT 3;

question: 客户所在州与卖家所在州相同的订单占全部已送达订单的比例是多少？(订单需经 order_items 关联到卖家；结果用 0~1 小数表示，如 0.36 表示 36%)
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(1.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.customer_state = s.seller_state THEN o.order_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 4) AS same_state_ratio FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered';

question: 各州客户的平均下单次数排名中，最高的前3个州是哪些？(先按客户去重统计每人的下单数，再按州求平均)
gold_sql: SELECT state, ROUND(AVG(order_cnt), 2) AS avg_orders FROM (SELECT c.customer_state AS state, c.customer_unique_id AS uid, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' GROUP BY c.customer_state, c.customer_unique_id) GROUP BY state ORDER BY avg_orders DESC LIMIT 3;

question: 一共下过5单及以上的客户有多少位(去重)？

question: 2017年每个月已送达订单的客单价中，哪个月客单价最高？(客单价=当月总金额含运费/当月订单数)
gold_sql: SELECT substr(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 7) AS ym, ROUND(SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS aov FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01' GROUP BY ym ORDER BY aov DESC LIMIT 1;

question: 收到评价总数超过50条的品类有哪些(按葡萄牙语品类名分组，需经商品表关联)？
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_category_name AS category, COUNT(*) AS review_cnt FROM order_reviews r JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.product_category_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 50 ORDER BY review_cnt DESC;

question: 已送达订单中，订单金额(含运费)在100到200雷亚尔之间的订单占多少比例？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(1.0 * (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o2.order_id) FROM orders o2 JOIN order_items oi2 ON o2.order_id = oi2.order_id WHERE o2.order_status='delivered' GROUP BY o2.order_id HAVING SUM(oi2.price + oi2.freight_value) >= 100 AND SUM(oi2.price + oi2.freight_value) <= 200) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_status='delivered'), 4) AS ratio;

question: 购买过3个及以上不同品类的客户有多少位(去重)？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_cnt FROM (SELECT c.customer_unique_id AS uid FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_category_name) >= 3);

question: 2018年相比2017年的销售额同比增速是多少？(增速=(2018销售额-2017销售额)/2017销售额，销售额含运费且只算已送达)
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(((SELECT SUM(oi2.price + oi2.freight_value) FROM orders o2 JOIN order_items oi2 ON o2.order_id = oi2.order_id WHERE o2.order_status='delivered' AND o2.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o2.order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01') - (SELECT SUM(oi1.price + oi1.freight_value) FROM orders o1 JOIN order_items oi1 ON o1.order_id = oi1.order_id WHERE o1.order_status='delivered' AND o1.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND o1.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01')) / (SELECT SUM(oi1.price + oi1.freight_value) FROM orders o1 JOIN order_items oi1 ON o1.order_id = oi1.order_id WHERE o1.order_status='delivered' AND o1.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND o1.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01'), 4) AS yoy;
